title: Frontal Theta Oscillations Predict Arithmetic Performance: A Multi-Dataset Replication Across 102 Participants with Strict Subject-Wise Validation
description: Reproducible multi-dataset EEG analysis of cognitive workload classification across PhysioNet MAT (N=36), STEW (N=48), and OpenNeuro DS007262 (N=18). Includes full feature extraction pipeline, SNWA interpretable model, PhD-level statistical audit, and all generated tables/figures.
